mapper.select: select ui.id, ui.phone, case when ud.real_name is not null and ud.real_name != '' then ud.real_name else ui.user_name end as name, ud.gender, ud.identity, ud.graduation_year, ud.wechat, ud.birthday, '' as avatar_placeholder, '' as desc_placeholder from user_info ui left join user_detail ud on ui.id = ud.user_id where ui.id = #{id}
mapper.update:
update user_info
phone = #{phone},
user_name = #{name},
where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into user_detail ( user_id, real_name, gender, identity, graduation_year, wechat, birthday ) values ( #{id}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{identity}, #{gradYear}, #{wechat}, #{birthday} )
